title: eval-harness: add prompt-regression CI hook and quality gating
author: Ava Martinez
description: Add a CI hook and gating logic to the eval-harness to fail PRs when prompt-set regression exceeds configured thresholds. Motivation: prevent quality regressions in models and prompt changes from landing without automated signal. This PR introduces: 1) a new GH Actions workflow (ci/eval-prompt-regression.yml) that runs the eval-harness on a curated prompt set for changed models/paths, 2) baseline artifact storage in S3-compatible test bucket and a small tool to compare current eval metrics against baseline thresholds, 3) a config file eval_harness/ci/regression_gate.yaml for per-prompt-set thresholds (accuracy_delta, rouge_delta, embedding_cosine), 4) updates to the eval-harness runner to emit machine-readable metrics and a --ci-mode flag, 5) docs and a short maintenance script (scripts/update-baselines.sh) to refresh baselines, and 6) unit tests for the gating comparator. Checklist: - [x] Add GH workflow - [x] Implement comparator and thresholds - [x] Emit JSON metrics - [x] Add unit tests - [x] Add docs and examples - [x] Run end-to-end on staging and fix flaky tests Related: Linear ENG-8421; blocked-by none. CI summary: initial run failed due to floating-point nondeterminism in one test; added determinism seed and bumped timeout; subsequent runs passed. Merge method: squash and merge. Notes on backwards compatibility: default thresholds are permissive; gating is opt-in per-repo via a small config flag. See release_notes for operational guidance.

release_notes: - Add eval-harness prompt-regression CI hook and gating tool. - Default gating is opt-in and configurable per prompt-set. - Baseline management script added for maintainers.
notes_on_operational_runbook: Maintainers: to enable gating for a repo add eval_harness/ci/regression_gate.yaml and set enabled: true. Use scripts/update-baselines.sh to refresh baselines; tag baseline artifacts with commit hash. If CI fails, check artifact availability and rerun with REBASELINE=true in workflow.
examples_running: See examples/ci/prompt-set.json for sample prompt list. Example workflow invocation uses matrix.include paths and will skip gating when no relevant files changed.
